title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
description: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments which follow meetings US envoys had with him and Russia's Vladimir Putin.

title: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC
description: The author of a major review on youth unemployment, due next week, acknowledges the change would mean some young people losing out on benefits.

title: Neets review won't be for the faint-hearted - and will test Burnham's appetite for a welfare fight
description: Milburn is not the first to try and fix the Neets problem - so what’s different this time round, asks Laura Kuenssberg.

title: Noel Fielding 'appalled' by jokes he made with Russell Brand
description: The Great British Bake Off presenter says he has not been in contact with the convicted rapist "for many years".

title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
description: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

title: Philippines takes the crown in first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
description: BBC's Jonathan Head reports from the first ever Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok.

title: Even Grand Theft Auto's original creators haven't been able to play GTA 6
description: Thirty years after they dreamt up the series, Dave Jones and Brian Baglow are as desperate as everyone else to get their hands on the new game.

title: The search to find a friend for Jojo the gorilla after a lifetime of being alone
description: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.

title: Brand, Walliams and Married at First Sight: Is this a reckoning for the entertainment industry?
description: Noor Nanji, culture correspondent, explores how these stories represent the consequences of changes that began years ago, rather than being a sudden cultural shift.
